target.title: fix(control-ui): improve session key display for direct chats with long identifiers
target.body:
Related: #61213 (partial fix — issue stays open for full priority scheme)

## What Problem This Solves

Long direct-chat session identifiers (e.g. `ou_67075ec667cac0a7feae2c5094fd27b2`, 30 chars; `user_1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef`, 36 chars) overflow the Sessions table cells and details panel in Control UI, making sessions hard to identify at a glance. Users on feishu/telegram/dingtalk direct chats with long open_ids see a wall of opaque characters instead of a recognizable session label.

## Why This Change Was Made

Scoped UI fix only — adds a dedicated `shortenSessionKeyForCell` helper in `ui/src/ui/session-display.ts`:

- Truncates identifiers >20 chars to `first_6...last_4` format (e.g. `ou_670...27b2`)
- Preserves full raw key in hover `title` attribute for debugging
- Keeps canonical `parseSessionKey` **unchanged** — no API/contract changes
- For non-direct keys (main/subagent/cron), defers to `parseSessionKey`'s fallback name directly (no prefix duplication)
- Applies only to Sessions table cell + details panel title

## Scope Clarification

This is a **partial fix for #61213**, addressing the immediate UI truncation need. The complete solution — full `binding.comment → agent.name → 技术标识符` priority scheme — is intentionally **out of scope** for this PR and should be tracked in a follow-up issue.

Issue #61213 stays open to track the complete priority implementation. This PR lands the user-facing pain point fix first.

## Data Model Compatibility

**No persisted/serialized state changes.**

- `shortenSessionKeyForCell` is a **pure display helper**, called only at render time in `renderRows()`
- `parseSessionKey` (canonical parser) is **unchanged** — same input/output contract
- No `JSON.stringify`, no `localStorage`, no config writes, no migration needed
- No upgrade impact — existing sessions render identically except long direct-chat IDs are truncated in display

## User Impact

- Sessions table cells no longer overflow horizontally
- Raw key still accessible via hover for debugging (no information loss)
- Identity rows (with `friendlyKeyLabel`) keep existing behavior — only fallback rows get truncation
- Short identifiers (≤20 chars) are unaffected
- Non-direct sessions (main/subagent/cron) render cleanly without prefix duplication

## Evidence

### Unit tests
- 21 new tests in `ui/src/ui/session-display.test.ts` (covers `parseSessionKey`, `shortenSessionKeyForCell`, `resolveSessionDisplayName`)
- 26 existing tests in `ui/src/ui/views/sessions.test.ts` (all still passing)
- **47 total passing** via `pnpm test -- ui/src/ui/session-display.test.ts ui/src/ui/views/sessions.test.ts`

### Visual behavior proof
Three screenshots in PR comments demonstrate the Sessions table cell, hover tooltip, and details panel paths after the fix. ClawSweeper assessed proof as 🐚 platinum hermit with media proof bonus.

### Maintainer review
@steipete reviewed and approved with explicit risk assessment:
> "Risk assessment: Low — Pure UI display change, no state/config/API modifications, comprehensive test coverage"

## Checklist

- [x] Related to #61213 (partial fix — issue stays open, NOT using "Closes" syntax)
- [x] `pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test` passes locally
- [x] 47 unit tests passing (21 new + 26 existing)
- [x] No changes to `parseSessionKey` (canonical parser preserved)
- [x] No persisted state changes (display-only)
- [x] No unrelated Gateway protocol doc changes (reverted)
- [x] No proof scripts committed (kept `scripts/` lint-clean)
- [x] Fixed prefix-duplication bug for non-direct keys (Subagent/Cron)
- [x] No `CHANGELOG.md` edit (per CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Fork PR with "Allow edits by maintainers" enabled
